blocks.text: The fact sheet is final. With the quarterly figures you sent now folded in and reconciled, every number in the {{fact:f:E-2022-001.client}} summary ties back to a source, and I have checked the totals twice against your filings so there is nothing in it I cannot stand behind.

Kimberly Le has matched the talking points to that same set, so the sheet and the messaging carry identical figures and a reporter working the two side by side will not find daylight between them. I have sent both across to Laura Bradley, who now has the full package in hand for the call she is setting with you.
Nothing further is needed from you before then, Sandra Mcdaniel; if a figure moves between now and the announcement, send it to me and I will refresh the sheet the same day.
